findings.subject: @atom63/mdx VideoBlock
findings.summary: VideoBlock can play an endless looping video with no pause control, and autoplay ignores prefers-reduced-motion.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/video-block/video-block.tsx:57-88 passes autoPlay/loop/controls straight to <video>; stories AutoplayLoop (video-block.stories.tsx:50-57) and DecorativeBackground (:59-71) ship autoPlay+loop+controls={false}; grep 'reduce' in video-block -> none. Fails WCAG 2.2.2 (Pause, Stop, Hide, level A).
findings.fix: Under useMdxReducedMotion() do not autoplay; whenever autoPlay is set and controls is false, render a labelled pause/play toggle over the video; add a test for both, and drop aria-label on captionPolicy='decorative' (aria-hidden instead).

verified.reason: Reproduced from source. video-block.tsx:56-88 forwards autoPlay, loop and controls straight to <video> with no pause control and no reduced-motion check. Grepping packages/mdx/src for prefers-reduced-motion/useReducedMotion finds only page-table-of-contents and the primitives/use-reduced-motion.ts helper, and VideoBlock does not use either. The AutoplayLoop and DecorativeBackground stories (video-block.stories.tsx:50-71) ship autoPlay+loop+controls={false}, so the package itself demonstrates an endless loop that cannot be paused. This fails WCAG 2.2.2 and the K2 reduced-motion requirement. Defaults (autoPlay=false, controls=true) are safe, so the failure needs opt-in props, but those props are documented and shown in stories.

findings.subject: @atom63/inform InformBanner, InformCornerFlyout, InformSpotlight (dismiss)
findings.summary: The inform dismiss control's target is a fixed 24px and does not grow to 44px on coarse pointers like every ui-react control.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-parts.css:46-51 ('inset: calc((1lh - 1.5rem) / 2)'); dismiss-button.tsx:15-18.
findings.fix: Size the ::after expansion from var(--a63-control-min-target) instead of 1.5rem, keeping the one-line layout box.

findings.subject: @atom63/inform InformSpotlight
findings.summary: In forced-colors mode the spotlight scrim and cutout vanish, because both are one box-shadow, and nothing marks the anchor.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-spotlight.css:18-23 'box-shadow: 0 0 0 9999px var(--a63-scrim)'; grep forced-colors over packages/{mdx,inform,widgets,brand}/src -> no matches.
findings.fix: Add @media (forced-colors: active) { .a63-InformSpotlight-cutout { outline: 3px solid Highlight; } } and give the bubble a CanvasText border; capture it with a forced-colors story.

findings.subject: @atom63/inform InformCornerFlyout, InformFlyoutStack, InformOutlet
findings.summary: The fixed corner flyout stack ignores safe-area insets, so a bottom flyout sits under the iPhone home indicator and a side one under the notch in landscape.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-corner-flyout.css:48-61 ('right: var(--a63-space-4)'); flyout-stack.tsx:45,61-62 (offset default '1rem' applied raw); grep 'safe-area|env(' over the package -> none.
findings.fix: Apply max(offset, env(safe-area-inset-bottom/top)) on the anchored edge and max(space-4, env(safe-area-inset-left/right)) on the side; add a phone story.

findings.subject: @atom63/inform InformCornerFlyout, InformFlyoutStack
findings.summary: Flyout placement only names physical corners, so RTL apps must swap it by hand, and the exit always slides to +X.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/flyout-stack.tsx:6; inform-corner-flyout.css:33-36 (exit translateX(space-4) for every placement), :56-61 ('The placement names a physical corner, so it does not mirror').
findings.fix: Add 'bottom-end' | 'bottom-start' | 'top-end' | 'top-start' using inset-inline-end/start (keep the physical names as aliases), and slide the exit toward the anchored inline edge.

findings.subject: @atom63/inform surfaces
findings.summary: Inform surfaces accept only className: no ref and no HTML attributes; severity says 'danger' where the rest of the system says 'error'.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/types.ts:9-34; dismiss-button.tsx:6-10; Callout uses 'error' (pattern-mdx.mdx:44) and the contract status set normalises to 'error' (contract-consistency-baseline.json 'status-set | alert-dialog.variants | destructive -> error').
findings.fix: Spread remaining HTML attributes onto each surface's root and accept ref; rename severity 'danger' to 'error' with 'danger' kept as a deprecated alias.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx CreditsBlock
findings.summary: CreditsBlock puts a fixed <h4> inside its toggle button, animates height and blur without honouring reduced motion, and has no designed focus style.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/credits-block/credits-block.tsx:30-31 (h4 inside CollapsibleTrigger), :37-71 (motion durations 0.15/0.25s, height+filter blur), credits-block.css:3-5 (hover ::before only); grep focus-visible in credits-block.* -> none; open state is internal only (:19-21).
findings.fix: Render the label as a span (or let the caller pick the heading level outside the button), drive the reveal from the ui-react Collapsible recipe (token durations, reduced motion), add a focus-visible outline, and accept open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx ImageCompare
findings.summary: ImageCompare's idle and on-leave reset animates the handle with a hard-coded easing and ignores reduced motion; keyboard use is untested.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/image-compare/image-compare.tsx:150 transition = '0.25s cubic-bezier(.17,.67,.83,.67)'; grep reduce in image-compare -> none; image-compare.test.tsx has 3 render tests and no keyboard test.
findings.fix: Default the transition to the --a63-control-feedback-* tokens, set it to none (and skip auto reset) under useMdxReducedMotion(), and add an arrow-key test.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx Callout
findings.summary: A Callout's type is carried only by tint and border; screen readers get no 'warning' or 'error', and the docs do not ask authors to say it in words.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/callout/callout.tsx:19-48 (tone only, no role, no hidden label, no default icon); apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/mdx-blocks-callout-all-types-chromium-linux.png; pattern-inform.mdx:208 has the 'carry severity in words' rule, pattern-mdx.mdx does not.
findings.fix: Render a visually hidden, localizable type label (a labels prop, defaulting to 'Warning:' etc.) before the body, or a default icon with that label; add the words rule to pattern-mdx.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx PageTableOfContents, ResourceList, MdxPageSkeleton, DemoConfigPanel, FigureBlock lightbox
findings.summary: Several blocks hard-code English accessible names, and two lowercase a translated label.
findings.evidence: page-table-of-contents.tsx:457 'Open page navigation', :406 `Open ${label.toLowerCase()}`; resource-list.tsx:101 'External resources'; mdx-page-skeleton.tsx:45 'Loading page content'; demo-config-panel.tsx:159 `Toggle ${label.toLowerCase()} controls`; lightbox/photo-swipe.tsx:41 'Image gallery'.
findings.fix: Move every such string to a labels prop with English defaults, as MermaidDiagram does (defaultMermaidDiagramLabels), and never derive a name by lowercasing.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx PageTableOfContents, ResourceList, DemoConfigPanel, FigureBlock lightbox
findings.summary: Physical left/right insets in four blocks do not mirror in RTL, and check:craft's physical-properties rule misses them.
findings.evidence: page-table-of-contents.tsx:49 'fixed ... right-4', :463 'right-0 ... left-0'; resource-list.css:42-43 'right:' / 'left: calc(...)' (divider start offset); demo-config-panel.tsx:126 right: 0; lightbox/figure-lightbox-trigger.tsx:45 'top-3 right-3'. check:craft passes (sweep-r1/summary.tsv), so the rule does not flag inset left/right or Tailwind right-N/left-N.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-end/start (end-4, start-0, inset-inline-end: 0); extend the craft physical-properties rule to left/right declarations and Tailwind left-*/right-* utilities.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx blocks without long-string or CJK stories (22 blocks)
findings.summary: Only Compare, KeyIdea, LayerStack and ImageCompare have a long-string or CJK story, so truncation and wrapping are unverified for the rest.
findings.evidence: Baselines: mdx-blocks-compare-dense-chinese-content, mdx-blocks-keyidea-chinese-article-note, mdx-blocks-layerstack-chinese-course-model, mdx-blocks-imagecompare-long-labels; none for Steps, Timeline, StatCard, PageMeta, ResourceList, Callout and the rest.
findings.fix: Add one long-and-CJK story per text-bearing block (as KeyIdea does) so the baseline covers wrapping.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx Callout, KeyIdea, ExampleContainer, prose map
findings.summary: These have one example each in the docs but no props or slot reference.
findings.evidence: pattern-mdx.mdx:59-72 (Callout and KeyIdea examples); Callout.Icon/Title/Body/Actions slots (callout.tsx:51-54) undocumented; ExampleContainer has no section; the mdxComponents element list is undocumented.
findings.fix: Document the props and slots in the same pass as the K8 P1 finding.

findings.subject: @atom63/widgets WidgetCard parts, WidgetImage
findings.summary: WidgetCard's parts drop all props except children/className/style, and WidgetCardProps and WidgetImageProps are not exported.
findings.evidence: packages/widgets/src/primitives/widget-card.tsx:70-260; packages/widgets/api/widgets.primitives.api.md:53-74 and widgets.api.md:185 (ae-forgotten-export).

findings.subject: @atom63/widgets WidgetAvatar, WidgetImage, WidgetLinkProvider

findings.subject: @atom63/widgets WidgetImage
findings.summary: WidgetImage's skeleton, crossfade and failure states have no story or baseline.
findings.evidence: packages/widgets/src/image.tsx:17-31,122; no widgets-image-* baseline in apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx VideoBlock
findings.summary: VideoBlock has no loading or load-failure state.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/video-block/video-block.tsx:73-110 (no poster prop, no onError fallback).

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx CreditsBlock, ResourceList
findings.summary: Interactive states of CreditsBlock (open, focus) and ResourceList rows (hover, focus-visible) are not captured.
findings.evidence: Baselines are closed/default only: mdx-blocks-creditsblock-default, mdx-blocks-resourcelist-default; runtime-craft-baseline.json has no entries for them.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx MermaidDiagram
findings.summary: The pannable Mermaid canvas has no touch story, so pinch/drag behaviour at coarse pointers is unverified.
findings.evidence: mermaid-diagram.tsx:394 canvas with transform; zoom buttons at :362-378; no -phone story.

findings.subject: @atom63/brand AppLogo
findings.summary: AppLogo cannot be renamed, marked decorative or given a ref or attributes.
findings.evidence: packages/brand/src/logo/app-logo.tsx:64-75 (four props), names hard-wired 'ATOM63' at :45,60,87,103.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx CodeBlock
findings.summary: CodeBlock branches on dark mode for Shiki colours (known craft debt).
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/code-block/code-block.tsx:81,135 'dark:[&_.shiki]:text-[var(--shiki-dark)]'; docs/design-system/audits/craft-baseline.json:2-3.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx Timeline
